title: 第1章 游戏商店系统第2章 购买与抽奖
content_zh:
第一章游戏商店系统
昏暗冰冷的钢铁牢房内，吵杂的谩骂声充斥其内，铁架床上只坐着一个犯人，神情呆滞地望着墙壁。
“这里是哪里？菲尼托斯监狱？真是一个糟糕的地方，离开我那可爱的金币真是遗憾啊！而且莉亚迪离开了我……等一下，我怎么说出这样的话？而且我怎么会在这？”
“我的名字叫布莱迪.罗尔？……”
他的双手紧抓着脑袋，仿佛精神分裂地呢喃着，“不不不！我叫做郝宁，家住地球G市的普通人，我怎么会来到这个地方？”
忽然郝宁愣住了，他感觉脑海里多出了一份不属于他的记忆。那段记忆里，一个小孩从出生到长大，第一次谈恋爱，第一次赚到钱，以及第一次被甩都一一涌现在他脑海中。
“见鬼……莉迪亚？那个婊.子关我屁事啊，估计墙壁里面的金币也让她拿走了，让她见鬼去吧！”
随着脑海中不断涌进的记忆，他开始相信自己是来到了另外一个世界，一个信仰着神明的世界。
郝宁以前是地球上一个普通的大学生，毕业后就没有外出工作，在家靠着写小说赚点小钱养活自己。某天他玩那款名叫《秩序之书》的网游时，这个游戏可是堪称世界上真实感最棒的电脑游戏，这导致几乎其他游戏的玩家瞬间转战这个游戏，其实最重要的是它对于电脑的配置不高。
眼看郝宁就要杀死BOSS窃取神器,突然间电脑死机，紧接着一阵停电，他回过神来就出现在这个肮脏的监狱。
当他回神过来，就发现自己坐在一间昏暗的牢房中，脑海里多出了一份不属于他的记忆，也变成了一个失恋的小偷。而这身体的原主人名字叫罗尔，不过也只是一个罪犯，估计过不了多久就会被处刑了吧！
但是原来那个“罪犯罗尔”以为失恋后被抓进监狱已经是非常糟糕的事情了。但是他万万没想到，身体会被一个外来者硬生生地占据。
他尔无力地往后倒去，后背重重撞在木板上，手中的一张小纸条缓缓滑落到脚边。
上面写着：我已经离开菲尼斯，再见了，布莱迪！我无法忍受自己跟一个小偷相爱，而且是一个即将被处刑的小偷！这是你给我的戒指，现在还给你，希望你不要怨恨我，也不要再相见了！
郝宁摊开紧攥着的拳头，一只闪闪发亮的金戒指躺在他的手掌中。不知为何他看着这个金戒指，心中就涌起无限怒火。
他现在的心情非常糟糕，虽然知道这情绪是来自于身体的原主人，但却依然压制不住这样糟糕的情绪。
“哼！”
他冷哼一声，愤愤不平地把戒指砸在地上，戒指在地面上翻滚了几下，歪歪斜斜地地滚进墙角的裂缝中。
郝宁环视着四周的环境，潮湿的墙壁上没能发现什么隐秘通道。他必须要从这里找到方法逃出去，说不定什么时候就会被押上刑场。
“叮！游戏商店开启！”

“宿主确认中，一阶级操作权限开放！”
忽然郝宁的视网膜上浮现出一行字幕，紧随着弹出一个熟悉的虚拟面板。他心中一惊，这不是他玩那个游戏里面的在线商店么？
难道他像是网上那些小说一样，能够将游戏中的物品带进来？如果真的如他想象那样，他就能真实地体验游戏中的技能了，一股兴奋感在他心中涌现。
郝宁心中的恐惧顿时减轻了很多，如果猜测是真的，他逃出这个监狱的几率就增大了很多。
顿时他将心中的杂念抛开，仔细望向那个虚拟面板。只见上面有武器—防具—药剂—图纸好几个分类。可惜是上面物品的名字都是白色，按照游戏的规则，这些都是最低级的白板装备。
“哎！白装就白装吧，总比没有要好！”
郝宁只好在这庞大的物品堆里，一样样地寻找自己能用得上的东西，有一些物品却需要一些限制，比如需要等级限制什么的。
没过多久郝宁就筛选出几样能够用得上的物品，一把枪管7英寸的黑色柯尔特蟒蛇左轮手枪，还有一把可以的隐身药剂。
待他选完后点击确认购买时才发现一件事，这些物品加在一起要整整300购买点数，系统竟然提示他的购买点数不够。
“我的购买点数竟然不够？”
他疑惑地望向虚拟面板，找遍整个界面都没法找到显示自己资产的数字。
难道还有个人界面？顿时郝宁心中默念一声个人界面，顿时身体各个部位就浮现出各项数据。
布莱迪.郝宁（HP/100.MP/100）
等级：0
职业：平民
力量：1
敏捷：1
体质：1
智力：1
意志力：20

郝宁看到这样的数据不由感叹起来，这简直是他见过史上最差的新手数据。终于他在个人属性面板下中看到自己的购买点数，一个代表着购买点数的钱币符号浮现着，紧随其后的就是一个大大的0字。
“你妹啊！怎么可能没有购买点数！”郝宁仿佛从天堂跌入地狱，刚拥有一个希望，瞬间就无情地破灭了。
“你好！这里是商店系统客服001为你服务，请问有什么能够帮助到你的吗？”
就在郝宁心灰意冷的时候，一把电子声音闯入他的耳朵。睁开眼一看，一个视频框框漂浮在那，一个身穿职业装脸上挂着僵硬笑容的女子直直地望着他。
客服001见郝宁愣住没有回答，便继续问道：“你好！有什么能够帮助到你的吗？”
郝宁差点咬掉自己的舌头，听着这把貌似某移动的客服声音，刹那间他还以为自己回到了地球。
“能够直接把我传送出去吗？”
“不好意思，我们并不能给予宿主任何实质上的帮助。请问还有什么问题吗？”
他好不容易才平复心中激动的心情：“好吧……这个购买点数怎么得到？”现在郝宁必须要得到一点购买点数，不然他根本无法从这个牢房内逃出去。
“你可以进行任务或者通过能量晶核进行兑换以上两种方法获得购买点数！任务会不定时向宿主发布，请耐心等候。”
顿时郝宁无语了，还要等，估计那时候自己早就上断头台并且死翘翘了。
那名女子仿佛知道郝宁心中的想法，顿了顿才说道：“其实只要是珍贵金属和带有强大力量的物品都可以进行兑换购买点数，根据成色不同，系统会自行评估价值。”
“比如刚刚宿主扔掉的戒指也算珍贵金属的一种，很高兴为你服务，如有疑问可以再次拨打客服热线！”话刚说完，那个视频框框就消失掉了。
黄金？等等，他刚刚不是把一只黄金戒指给扔了吗？
郝宁心中一惊，连滚带爬地冲到那个墙角，他现在无比后悔把戒指给扔了出去，把这个生存的希望给扔了。
“我艹！怎么这缝隙这么窄的啊，怎么都插不到底啊！”
郝宁懊恼地把手想伸进裂缝里，把金戒指给勾出来。但是他发现裂缝的大小根本不能容纳他的手掌，只能伸进两个手指。但是戒指滚进裂缝的深处，手指的长度根本够不到，一不小心锋利的石头还把他的手指割破了。
“啊！真疼！”
此时郝宁却不知道自己那充满歧义的话，已经引起了隔壁的囚犯以及不远处的狱卒注意。
“哈哈哈！新来的家伙到底有多强啊，竟然插墙壁！”

“不！我觉得他那东西没有那么坚硬，最多也只是插那块腐烂的木板！”
“哈哈哈，我觉得也是，幸好我不是在那间牢房！”
那些无聊的囚犯对于罗尔的话，都纷纷发表了自己的意见。
昏暗的烛光照耀下，狱卒威尔孤独地喝着老多尔送来的麦酒。
忽然他竟然听到那样下流的话！他的脑海里瞬间浮现出昨晚他妻子叱喝他不行的场景，顿时一股既妒忌夹杂着愤怒的情绪悄然涌上心头。
他猛然拿起桌上的制式长剑，不顾同伴诧异的目光，径直朝着郝宁所在的牢房快步走去。透过铁栏他看到这个新来的犯人匍匐在地上，脸上还露出既痛苦而又兴奋的表情。
瞬间狱卒心里充满了自卑，随即转变成愤怒，他攥着长剑就往铁栏上敲去，噹噹噹！沉闷的敲击声瞬间让整个监狱安静了下来。
“该死，你这恶心的家伙，要是你再发出这样的声音，我就杀了你！如果你不相信，你会为你那污浊的行为付出代价的！”
狱卒极度愤恨地抛下这么一句话后，就脸色阴沉地走回刚刚坐着的位置。
“什么，他疯了？”郝宁爬起来盘膝坐在地上，疑惑地抬起头看着离开的狱卒。
好吧，我还是想想其他方法把戒指弄出来吧，要是能够有一条棍子就好了！
但郝宁却万万没想到，他刚刚的话已经触及到狱卒内心一辈子的痛，男人最自卑的事情，不举。
哐当！监狱通往外界的大门被着一个身形健硕的犯人。
看到这些骑兵团的骑士，刚还十分凶狠的狱卒威尔瞬间变成了一只哈巴狗，紧忙上前笑脸相迎：“这是新来的犯人吗？交给我就行了……三位大人。”
“不！这个犯人我们必须要亲自押送，而且他只是在这里关押一段时间，过段时间要被转送到奥德拉斯，你要管理好这个监狱！”
三名骑士带着犯人径直掠过狱卒身边，瞬间让满脸笑容的威尔变得非常尴尬。
郝宁依然坐在地上思考怎么拿出金戒指，咔嚓，突然听到开锁的声音，心中一惊，他还以为那个狱卒已经忍不住要杀掉自己了。
他连忙从地上站起来回头望去，只见一个浑身被绑着锁链，只剩下双腿能够活动的犯人被跄跄踉踉地推了进来。三名骑士就连看都没看郝宁，直接关上牢房的门径直离去。
只是一个新来的犯人，顿时郝宁松了一口气，至少不是那个狱卒要把他带去行刑。
估计是三位骑士都离开了，通道上又传来狱卒那凶狠而又尖锐的声音：“你们都给安分一点！特别是那个前段时间来的变.态小偷！”

Chapter 1 Game Store System
The dark and cold steel cell was filled with noisy curses. There was only one prisoner sitting on the iron frame bed, staring blankly at the wall.
"Where is here? Finitos Prison? It's such a terrible place. It's such a shame to leave my lovely gold coins! And Liadi left me...wait a minute, how could I say such a thing? And why am I here?"
"My name is Brady Rolle?..."
He clutched his head with both hands and muttered as if he was schizophrenic, "No, no, no! My name is Hao Ning, an ordinary person who lives in City G on Earth. How did I end up here?"
Suddenly Hao Ning was stunned. He felt that there was an extra memory in his mind that did not belong to him. In that memory, a child's first love, first time making money, and first time being dumped all came to his mind from birth to growing up.
"What the hell...Lydia? That bitch is none of my business. She probably took away the gold coins in the wall. Let her go to hell!"
As the memories continued to pour into his mind, he began to believe that he had come to another world, a world where gods believed.
Hao Ning used to be an ordinary college student on earth. He did not work outside the home after graduation and earned a small amount of money by writing novels at home to support himself. One day when he was playing an online game called "Book of Order", this game was regarded as the most realistic computer game in the world. This caused players of almost other games to instantly switch to this game. In fact, the most important thing is that it does not require high computer configurations.
Just as Hao Ning was about to kill the BOSS and steal the artifact, his computer suddenly crashed, followed by a power outage. When he came to his senses, he appeared in this dirty prison.
When he came back to his senses, he found himself sitting in a dark cell. There was an extra memory in his mind that did not belong to him, and he became a lovelorn thief. The original owner of this body is named Luo Er, but he is just a criminal, and he will probably be executed soon!
But it turns out that "criminal Roll" thought that being arrested and sent to jail after falling out of love was already a very bad thing. But he never expected that his body would be forcibly taken over by an outsider.
He fell back weakly, his back hitting the wooden board hard, and a small piece of paper in his hand slowly slipped to his feet.
It read: I have left Phoenix, goodbye Brady! I can't bear to fall in love with a thief, and a thief who is about to be executed! This is the ring you gave me. I give it back to you now. I hope you won’t resent me and never see me again!
Hao Ning opened his clenched fists, and a shiny gold ring lay in his palm. For some reason, when he looked at this golden ring, infinite anger surged in his heart.
He is in a very bad mood now. Although he knows that this mood comes from the original owner of the body, he still cannot suppress such bad mood.
"Hmph!"
He snorted coldly and smashed the ring on the ground angrily. The ring rolled a few times on the ground and rolled crookedly into the crack in the corner of the wall.
Hao Ning looked around the surrounding environment and found no hidden passages on the damp walls. He must find a way to escape from here, maybe he will be taken to the execution ground at some point.
"Ding! The game store is open!"
"The host is being confirmed, and first-level operation permissions are open!"
Suddenly, a line of subtitles appeared on Hao Ning's retina, followed by a familiar virtual panel. He was shocked, wasn't this the online store in the game he was playing?
Could it be that he is like those novels on the Internet, able to bring in items from the game? If it was really as he imagined, he would be able to truly experience the skills in the game, and a sense of excitement emerged in his heart.
The fear in Hao Ning's heart suddenly eased a lot. If he guessedIt's true, his chances of escaping from this prison will increase a lot.
He immediately put aside the distracting thoughts in his mind and looked at the virtual panel carefully. I saw that there were several categories on it: weapons, armor, potions, and blueprints. Unfortunately, the names of the items above are all white. According to the rules of the game, these are the lowest level whiteboard equipment.
"Hey! Just pretend to be white, it's better than nothing!"
Hao Ning had no choice but to look for things that he could use in this huge pile of items. Some items required some restrictions, such as level restrictions.
It didn't take long for Hao Ning to select a few useful items, including a black Colt Python revolver with a 7-inch barrel, and a useful invisibility potion.
After he finished selecting and clicked to confirm the purchase, he discovered something. These items together cost a full 300 purchase points, and the system actually prompted him that he did not have enough purchase points.
"I don't have enough purchase points?"
He looked at the virtual panel in confusion, searching the entire interface but unable to find the numbers showing his assets.
Is there a personal interface? Hao Ning suddenly recited the personal interface in his mind, and various data appeared in various parts of his body.
Brady Hao Ning (HP/100.MP/100)
Level: 0
Occupation: Civilian
Strength: 1
Agility: 1
Constitution: 1
Intelligence: 1
Willpower: 20
Hao Ning couldn't help but sigh when he saw such data. This was simply the worst rookie data he had ever seen. Finally, he saw his purchase points in the personal attributes panel. A coin symbol representing the purchase points appeared, followed by a big 0.
"Your sister! How can you not have purchase points!" Hao Ning seemed to have fallen from heaven to hell. He had just had a hope, but it was ruthlessly shattered in an instant.
"Hello! This is the store system customer service 001 to serve you. Is there anything I can help you with?"
Just when Hao Ning was frustrated, an electronic sound broke into his ears. When he opened his eyes, he saw a video frame floating there, with a woman in business attire looking straight at him with a stiff smile on her face.
Customer service 001 saw that Hao Ning was stunned and did not answer, so he continued to ask: "Hello! How can I help you?"
Hao Ning almost bit off his tongue. Listening to the voice that sounded like a mobile customer service, for a moment he thought he was back on earth.
"Can you teleport me directly?"
"Sorry, we can't give the host any substantial help. Do you have any questions?"
He finally calmed down the excitement in his heart: "Okay... how to get these purchase points?" Now Hao Ning must get some purchase points, otherwise he will not be able to escape from this cell.
"You can complete tasks or redeem them through energy crystal cores to obtain purchase points through the above two methods! Tasks will be released to the host from time to time, please wait patiently."
Hao Ning was speechless. He still had to wait. He would probably be on the guillotine and dead by then.
The woman seemed to know what Hao Ning was thinking. She paused and then said, "Actually, as long as it is precious metals and items with powerful power, you can exchange them for points. The system will evaluate the value by itself based on the quality."
"For example, the ring that the host just threw away is considered a kind of precious metal. I am happy to serve you. If you have any questions, you can call the customer service hotline again!" As soon as he finished speaking, the video frame disappeared.
gold? Wait, didn't he just throw away a gold ring?
Hao Ning was shocked and rushed to the corner. He now regretted throwing the ring and the hope of survival.
"Fuck! Why is this gap so narrow? I can't get it all the way in!"Hao Ning angrily tried to put his hand into the crack and pull out the gold ring. But he found that the size of the crack could not accommodate his palm at all, and he could only fit two fingers in. But the ring rolled into the depths of the crack, and his fingers couldn't reach it. The sharp stone accidentally cut his finger.
"Ah! It hurts!"
At this time, Hao Ning did not know that his ambiguous words had attracted the attention of the prisoners next door and the jailer not far away.
"Hahaha! How strong is the new guy? He can actually insert himself into the wall!"
"No! I don't think his thing is that hard. At most, it can only be inserted into the rotten wooden board!"
"Hahaha, I think so. Fortunately, I'm not in that cell!"
The bored prisoners all expressed their opinions on Rohr's words.
Under the dim candlelight, jailer Will drank the ale sent by Old Dole alone.
Suddenly he heard such obscene words! The scene where his wife scolded him last night suddenly appeared in his mind, and suddenly a feeling of jealousy mixed with anger quietly surged into his heart.
He suddenly picked up the standard long sword on the table, ignored the surprised looks of his companions, and walked quickly towards the cell where Hao Ning was. Through the iron bars, he saw the new prisoner lying on the ground, with an expression of pain and excitement on his face.
For a moment, the jailer was filled with inferiority complex, and then it turned into anger. He grabbed the long sword and knocked on the iron fence, bang, bang, bang! The dull knocking sound instantly silenced the entire prison.
"Damn it, you disgusting guy, if you make such a sound again, I will kill you! If you don't believe it, you will pay the price for your dirty behavior!"
After saying these words with extreme resentment, the jailer walked back to where he was sitting with a gloomy face.
"What, is he crazy?" Hao Ning got up and sat cross-legged on the ground, looking up at the leaving jailer in confusion.
Well, I'd better think of another way to get the ring out, if only I had a stick!
But Hao Ning never expected that what he just said would touch the pain in the jailer's heart for a lifetime. The most humiliating thing for a man is not to mention it.
Bang! The prison door leading to the outside world was blocked by a muscular prisoner.
Seeing these knights of the cavalry regiment, the jailer Will, who was very fierce just now, instantly turned into a pug, and hurriedly stepped forward to greet them with a smile: "Is this a new prisoner? Just leave it to me... three adults."
"No! We must personally escort this prisoner, and he will only be held here for a period of time. He will be transferred to Odras after a while. You must manage this prison well!"
The three knights led the prisoner straight past the jailer, instantly making the smiling Will very embarrassed.
Hao Ning was still sitting on the ground thinking about how to take out the gold ring. He suddenly heard the sound of unlocking the door and was shocked. He thought the jailer couldn't help but want to kill him.
He quickly stood up from the ground and looked back, only to see a prisoner who was tied up in chains and could only move his legs being pushed in staggeringly. The three knights didn't even look at Hao Ning, they closed the cell door and left.
It was just a new prisoner, and Hao Ning was relieved. At least it was not the jailer who wanted to take him to execution.
It was estimated that the three knights had left, and the jailer's fierce and sharp voice came from the passage: "You all should be at ease! Especially that perverted thief who came here some time ago!"
